tldr: Inflation eased slightly in July, with wholesale prices flattening, offering some relief to the cost of living.
Civilian deaths in Ukraine reached their highest level in July since May 2022, with 437 fatalities reported.
Europe is experiencing widespread severe heatwave conditions, with over 135 million people projected to face temperatures above 35C.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite advanced as easing inflation pressures, including flat wholesale prices in July, contributed to positive market sentiment.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield remained unchanged, influenced by signs of easing price pressures within the economy as wholesale inflation flattened out in July.

vix.why: The VIX decreased, indicating a reduction in market volatility and fear, likely stemming from the reported easing of inflation pressures.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Scientists have successfully created female clones of male mice for the first time by employing a CRISPR-based approach to remove the Y chromosome from male cells.
A new "ShieldFont" has been developed to disrupt AI scrapers by rendering ordinary webpages as nonsense for AI training data while remaining fully readable for human users.
A significant supply-chain attack led to the leak of terabytes of credentials from 2,500 users of a compromised AI software package.

world.summary: Civilian deaths in Ukraine reached their highest monthly level in July since May 2022, with the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission reporting at least 437 civilians killed and 2,610 injured.
Over 135 million people across Europe are expected to face temperatures above 35C as the continent experiences widespread and severe heatwave conditions.
California has banned paraquat, a highly toxic herbicide that is already prohibited in more than 70 other countries, due to its nearly proven link to Parkinson's disease.
